remarks: An upstairs loft, a spacious upstairs bathroom layout and extra enclosed garage storage give this Caspian Villas townhome useful space beyond the bedrooms. Approximately 1,630 square feet include three upstairs bedrooms, two upstairs bathrooms and a downstairs powder room. The open main level connects the kitchen, dining and living areas, keeping everyday meals and time with friends together. Upstairs, create a home office, movie lounge or reading retreat in the loft. A patio extends the living space outdoors, while enclosed storage in the attached two-car garage helps organize tools, seasonal items and weekend gear.
